documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Notice Of Extra-Ordinary General Meeting Scheduled To Be Held On October 27, 2026
Disclosure Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ('LODR Regulations')
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported financial performance for FY19 and Q1FY20, noting a 3% growth in reported revenues for FY19 and double-digit growth during the summer season. Management highlighted challenges from severe weather conditions in domestic markets contrasted with strong international expansion crossing the $20 million milestone. The company outlined capital expenditure plans of Rs. 30-35 crore for the year, alongside a continued focus on debt rationalization and margin improvement. Furthermore, management emphasized ongoing strategic initiatives in distribution, product innovation, and retail expansion across domestic and global markets.

guidance.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore in capital expenditure during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: Management sees another good year in FY20 as the Vadilal brand is leveraged for ongoing growth.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

guidance.claim: Management maintains a positive business outlook driven by a better consumption environment and demand shift to the organized sector.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions extending winter and impacting ice cream consumption.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues continued to cross the $20 million milestone backed by 54% revenue growth during FY19.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19.

demand_outlook.claim: International business is now over 25% of revenues driven by strong demand for ice creams and other products within the Indian diaspora in the U.S. and other geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: International business is now over 25% of revenues and growth is driven by strong demand for our high quality ice creams and other products within the sizeable Indian diaspora community in the U.S. and some other geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double-digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in the international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is reverting to historical trends after being temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Latent demand for quality Indian products is driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic ice cream volumes expanded by 6.9% in Q2, driven by a 6% growth in the domestic business and a 37% expansion in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q2, we have continued our strong business momentum to expand ice cream volumes by 6.9%, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in the international business.

demand_outlook.claim: International business revenues grew by 53% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: International business revenues grew by 53% yoy

demand_outlook.claim: International business witnessed robust demand as VIL expanded distribution for the Indian diaspora in the US and other geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: International business has witnessed robust demand as VIL expanded distribution and is selling products focused on Indian diaspora in the US and other geographies

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY20 is approximately Rs. 30 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 20 at ~ Rs. 30 crore

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and larger contribution from international operations.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year with large contributions from U.S. operations having over 50 employees.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: Based on raw material purchase and inventory position, stable costs are covered till Q2.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: The company will look to increase prices in the second half of the year as milk prices are at higher levels now.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have continued to expand – gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: On a nine-month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

margins_costs.claim: Input cost visibility is clear having closed key supply arrangements for the upcoming summer season.
margins_costs.quote: Having already closed key supply arrangements for the upcoming summer season, we have clear visibility of input costs and expect strong contribution from sales.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices continue to be subdued for the next season, which should benefit margins.
margins_costs.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity was expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: Current production utilizes automated processes untouched by hand with manual intervention only at the packaging stage.
orders_capacity.quote: Current production on automated processes “untouched by hand”, manual intervention only at packaging stage

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal's current production capacity across facilities stands at 380,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote:  Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal products currently reach 55,000 retail outlets across 26 states.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

capital_allocation.claim: Outstanding debt was reconstituted to increase long tenure loans and reduce the cost of debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions extending winter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
